name: ticket-api

dependencies.name: triage-agent
dependencies.description: Classifies a newly-submitted ticket's urgency and drafts its reply, and drafts a fresh reply when a Support Agent rejects one.

description: Owns the ticket queue: accepts new tickets pushed by external ticketing systems on a public, credential-checked endpoint, calls triage-agent to classify urgency and draft a reply, and serves the protected queue/detail/approve/reject/override operations the Support Agent console calls. Records every state change as a ticket event for the audit history. Does not send the approved reply to the customer — that is another system's job — and holds no per-agent ticket assignment.
